nodes.description: Constructor: assigns fee wallets, mints full reflection supply to msg.sender, sets fee-exclusion list.
ERC20 transfer: delegates to internal _transfer with _msgSender() as sender.
ERC20 transferFrom: delegates to _transfer and reduces allowance via SafeMath.sub.
ERC20 approve: writes _allowances for msg.sender/spender.
Internal _transfer: applies fee logic, bot/cooldown/maxTx/maxWallet checks and may trigger swap-and-send-ETH.
Swaps contract token balance for ETH through the Uniswap router using block.timestamp as deadline, guarded by lockTheSwap.
Splits contract ETH balance in half and pushes it to the two fee wallets with .transfer.
Owner-only: deploys/links Uniswap pair, adds initial liquidity, opens trading, sets limits and openBlock.
Publicly callable manual swap of the whole contract token balance (no access control).
Publicly callable function that pushes the whole ETH balance to fee wallets (no access control).
Applies reflection amounts to _rOwned, takes team fee and reflects the fee.
Mints team reflection tokens to the contract address in _rOwned.
Reduces _rTotal and increases _tFeeTotal by the fee amounts.
Owner-only setter of _maxTxAmount (scaled by 10**9).
Owner-only: excludes an address from fees.
Owner-only: blacklists an address in bots.
Owner-only: removes an address from the bots blacklist.
Owner-only setter of the swap threshold _swapTokensAtAmount.
Owner-only toggles the cooldown feature.
Owner-only setter of _maxWalletAmount (scaled by 10**9).
Owner-only: sets the owner to address(0).
Reflection balance mapping used as the primary accounting store.
Declared token balance mapping (unused in logic).
ERC20 allowance mapping written by approve/transferFrom.
Fee-exclusion whitelist mapping controlling fee logic branches.
Blacklist mapping checked in _transfer.
Per-address timestamp gate for buys, written and read using block.timestamp.
Total reflection supply, reduced on every fee reflection.
Accumulated token fees.
Max transaction amount enforced on buys.
Block number when trading opened, used for the anti-bot high-fee window.
Contract token balance threshold that triggers a swap.
Max wallet holding enforced on buys.
Tax fee percentage used by _getTValues.
Team fee percentage used by _getTValues.
First ETH fee recipient wallet.
Second ETH fee recipient wallet.
Uniswap V2 router instance used for swaps and liquidity.
Token/WETH pair address created in openTrading.
Flag guarding single-call initialization of trading.
Reentrancy guard flag set by lockTheSwap.
Enables automatic contract-token swaps.
Enables the per-wallet cooldown requirement.
Ownership address checked by the onlyOwner modifier.
msg.sender / _msgSender(): untrusted caller used as transfer sender and owner check.
block.timestamp: miner-influenced value used as swap deadline and cooldown gate.
External call to uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens with deadline block.timestamp.
External payable call to uniswapV2Router.addLiquidityETH forwarding the whole contract ETH balance.
Two ETH pushes to fee wallets via address.transfer, executed before/after state-finalizing accounting.
External call to IUniswapV2Factory.createPair whose return value defines uniswapV2Pair.
amount parameter of _transfer.
from parameter of _transfer.
to parameter of _transfer.
tokenAmount parameter of swapTokensForEth.
amount parameter of sendETHToFee.
contractTokenBalance local computed in _transfer for the swap threshold check.
contractETHBalance local read from address(this).balance in _transfer.
tAmount parameter of _transferStandard.
tTeam parameter/local of _takeTeam used for the reflection team fee.
amount parameter of setMaxTxAmount, scaled by 10**9.
adr1 parameter of whitelist.
theBot parameter of addBot.

edges.reason: transfer delegates the whole transfer logic to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates the transfer logic to _transfer.
approve writes the spender allowance into _allowances.
_transfer performs an external swap via swapTokensForEth before finishing recipient accounting.
_transfer pushes ETH to fee wallets through sendETHToFee in the middle of the transfer flow.
_transfer finalizes accounting through _transferStandard.
manualSwap is externally callable without onlyOwner and invokes swapTokensForEth on the full contract balance.
manualSend is externally callable without onlyOwner and drains contract ETH to fee wallets.
_transferStandard takes the team fee via _takeTeam.
_transferStandard reflects the fee via _reflectFee.
swapTokensForEth forwards tokenAmount to the external router swap call.
sendETHToFee forwards half the amount to each fee wallet using .transfer.
openTrading calls addLiquidityETH with the contract ETH balance and token balance.
openTrading calls factory.createPair to obtain the pair address.
openTrading stores the router address in uniswapV2Router.
openTrading stores the created pair in uniswapV2Pair.
openTrading enables automatic swapping.
openTrading enables the cooldown gate.
openTrading sets the max transaction amount.
openTrading sets the max wallet amount.
openTrading flips tradingOpen; without the require it would be re-initializable.
openTrading records the current block number in openBlock.
Constructor credits the full reflection supply to the untrusted deployer msg.sender.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the sender of the transfer.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as spender when decreasing allowance.
_transfer branch logic compares from/to against owner() derived from msg.sender-controlled state.
onlyOwner compares _owner with _msgSender(), i.e. the untrusted caller.
_transfer enforces cooldown[to] < block.timestamp, making transfers timestamp dependent.
_transfer writes cooldown[to] = block.timestamp + 30 seconds.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the router deadline.
openTrading passes block.timestamp as the liquidity deadline.
_transfer ultimately updates reflection balances in _rOwned.
_transferStandard subtracts from sender and adds to recipient in _rOwned.
_takeTeam adds team reflection tokens to the contract entry of _rOwned.
_reflectFee reduces _rTotal by rFee.
_reflectFee increases _tFeeTotal by tFee.
setMaxTxAmount multiplies the argument by 10**9 before storing in _maxTxAmount.
setSwapTokens writes the swap threshold.
setCooldownEnabled toggles cooldownEnabled.
setMaxWalletAmount multiplies the argument by 10**9 before storing in _maxWalletAmount.
whitelist sets _isExcludedFromFee[adr1] to true.
addBot sets bots[theBot] to true.
delBot clears bots[notbot].
renounceOwnership writes address(0) into the _owner state variable.
_transfer requires that neither party is present in the bots blacklist.
amount parameter flows into _transfer fee and limit checks.
from parameter drives the fee/AI branch selection inside _transfer.
to parameter drives pair, cooldown and max-wallet checks inside _transfer.
tokenAmount parameter is used as the swap input amount.
amount parameter is divided by two and pushed to both fee wallets.
contractTokenBalance local is compared with _swapTokensAtAmount inside _transfer.
contractETHBalance local is forwarded to sendETHToFee.
tAmount parameter is decomposed into reflection/fee values in _transferStandard.
tTeam parameter is converted to reflections and added to contract balance.
amount parameter of setMaxTxAmount is multiplied by 10**9 before storage.
adr1 parameter is written into the fee-exclusion mapping by an owner-only function.
theBot parameter is written into the bots blacklist by an owner-only function.

normalization_plan.reason: amount is a transient parameter of the core function _transfer; merge it into _transfer.
from is a transient parameter of the core function _transfer; merge it into _transfer.
to is a transient parameter of the core function _transfer; merge it into _transfer.
tokenAmount is a transient parameter of swapTokensForEth; merge it into that function.
amount is a transient parameter of sendETHToFee; merge it into that function.
contractTokenBalance is a local computed and consumed inside _transfer; merge it into _transfer.
contractETHBalance is read in _transfer and forwarded to sendETHToFee; merge it into sendETHToFee.
tAmount is the input of _transferStandard; merge it into that function.
tTeam is the input of _takeTeam; merge it into that function.
amount is a transient parameter of setMaxTxAmount; merge it into that function.
adr1 is a transient parameter of whitelist; merge it into that function.
theBot is a transient parameter of addBot; merge it into that function.
